disposition_reason: Packaged mango juice brands with mean ± SD (mg/L) for eight elements in Table 4.

study.design: Retail survey of packaged mango-flavored fruit juices, 12 brands x 3 containers, with in vitro bioaccessibility and risk assessment
study.origin: Commercial brands produced in Pakistan (not stated individually)
study.method: Acid digestion; ICP-OES (Agilent) for Al, Cd, Cr, Cu, Ni, Pb, Zn; ICP-MS for As
study.lod_text: in Supplementary Table S1 (not in the PDF)
study.qa: matrix-blank calibration, R2 1.00000; triplicate measurement; recoveries in Supplementary Table S1

regulatory_or_exposure.what: WHO (2017) limits as printed in Table 4 (mg/L)
Codex maximum level for Pb in fruit juice, as cited

unresolved: Text says Pb exceeded the Codex 0.03 mg/kg in seven brands, but only two brands (2 and 12, 0.05 mg/L) exceed 0.03 in Table 4 and two more equal it.
Pb is described in mg/kg in the text but mg/L in Table 4; values kept per litre, unconverted.
Cd p-value differs between Table 4 (0.6148) and text (F = 0.79, p = 0.6454).
Detection and quantification limits are in Supplementary Table S1, not in the PDF; Cd means near 0.001 mg/L by ICP-OES may be near the limit.
Bioaccessibility percentages (Table 5, in vitro digestion) are not concentrations and are not recorded as findings.
Collection dates are not reported; Hg was not measured.
